==About==

{{i|Fruity Salad}} does '''NOT''' need to be cooked. Fruity Salad will become {{i|Spoiled Food}} if not eaten within 3 days. Fruity Salad is [[Gluttony#Double Variable Recipe|Double Variable Recipe]].
